facts.value: Erasmus+ Staff Mobility for Training must ensure that the receiving institution/enterprise is either a university awarded with an Erasmus Charter for Higher Education or any public or private organization.

small, medium or large enterprises (including social enterprises), public bodies at local, regional or national level, social partners or representatives of working life (including chambers of commerce, craft/professional associations, trade unions), research institutes, foundations, educational centres, non-profit organizations, associations, NGOs, bodies providing career guidance, professional counselling, and information services.
